name: Home view loads with greeting and navigation

actions.comment: Was `.sidebar-logo` asserted to read 'MTW'. That element is gone — app.css still carries the orphan rule, but no component renders it. The brand mark now lives in the header as an , and the product is Kernl, not MTW.

greeting() returns 'Good morning' / 'Good afternoon' / 'Good evening'. The user's name was dropped from the header when the dashboard was de-personalised for the open-source build, so asserting 'Matias' could never pass again.

expect: The dashboard should be fully loaded, showing a 'Good [time]' greeting, the Kernl mascot logo in the header, and navigation items in the sidebar

name: KPI cards are rendered on home view
expect: The dashboard home view should be visible with KPI cards if a provider is configured, or the providers onboarding view

name: Today's Focus and Recent Activity panels render

actions.comment: `.layout` was the old shell wrapper; the SvelteKit layout renders `.main-content` (with `.main-inner` inside it) instead.

expect: Dashboard main content area and sidebar should be present and rendering

name: Tasks view shows velocity and completion stats

actions.comment: Tasks is an extension page now (productivity/tasks) and it does not use the shared BarChart component, so `.bars` / `.bar-r` never render here. Its own breakdown markup is `.stats-row` > `.stat-card`. Waiting on the selector rather than sleeping — the page shows `.loading-view` until its first fetch resolves.

expect: The Tasks view should display its stats row with the Velocity and Completion cards, plus the by-context breakdown bars

name: People view shows contact analytics
expect: The People view should show KPI cards (Total, With Email, With Phone, No Interaction), coverage grid with percentages, and bar charts for By Relationship and By Source

name: Reminders view renders
expect: The Reminders view should display KPI cards (Active, Snoozed, Fired Today, Recurring), Overdue and Upcoming 24h panels, and a By Status bar chart

name: Shopping view renders
expect: The Shopping view should show Low Stock and Active Lists panels with relevant data or empty state messages

name: System overview shows KPIs and the overview grid

actions.comment: Replaces the old '/#analytics' case. There is no analytics view in this build — `analytics` survives only as a WebSocket channel name, and its markup (`.pipe-step`) exists nowhere; app.css kept the orphan rules for a while but no component ever shipped here. /sysoverview is the equivalent live surface: system KPIs plus the overview grid.

expect: The System overview should show a KPI row and the overview grid with system cards and quick actions

name: API health endpoint returns OK
expect: The browser should display raw JSON containing status: ok, uptimeMs, and uptimeFormatted fields

name: API dashboard endpoint returns full JSON

actions.comment: Fetched rather than navigated: /api/* needs a Bearer token and a plain browser navigation cannot send one, so navigating here only ever yields 401. The token is the one the login step already put in localStorage.
actions.value: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/dashboard', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('kernel_auth_token') } }); document.title = r.ok ? 'api-ok ' + JSON.stringify(Object.keys(await r.json())) : 'api-fail ' + r.status; })(); true;

expect: The browser should display raw JSON with the full dashboard payload including generatedAt, kpis, tasks, crm, reminders, and shopping sections
